remarks: Charming 2-Bedroom Upper-Level Apartment - 2nd Floor Enjoy the ease of ranch-style living in this freshly painted, second-floor unit featuring two comfortable bedrooms and one full bathroom. The spacious kitchen and beautiful wood flooring throughout add warmth and character, while abundant closet space offers plenty of storage. Bright, clean, and move-in ready!  Details: Includes one designated driveway parking spot (street parking available for a second vehicle or guests). Heat and trash removal are included. Tenant responsible for electric and propane gas used for stove cooking. Tenants are responsible for providing their own window unit air conditioners if they wish to have A/C. Within walking distance and quick access to downtown, restaurants, shopping and train station.
